run_embed_wgsl: run embed_wgsl.py to embed all .wgsl shader files from input_dir into a C++ output file
build_shader_embedder: build a C++ header with embedded WGSL shader strings using embed_wgsl.py with --input_dir and --output_file
test_expand_includes: test the expand_includes function to recursively resolve #include directives in WGSL shader code
refactor_chunk_shader: refactor the chunk_shader function to split large shader code into chunks under a given max length
review_write_shader: review the write_shader function that generates C++ code for embedding WGSL shaders as raw string literals
